answer: Proof of stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with committed capital rather than identity count. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake accounts faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring enough assets to gain majority control. Like an indelible pigment staining a sable brush to mark a valuable relic, the economic stake forces a tangible sacrifice that makes spoofing computationally and financially irrational for any rational agent.
